saw_lines: Boat owners rarely browse for gear. They search for one failed part, know its size, and buy before the next sail.
So the sale is won or lost on the product page, where a buyer checks fit, price and delivery in seconds.
Your 123 Google creatives include only 2 images and 1 video, next to 37 text ads. Shoot real photos of your top sellers and run them in the next batch.
ads_1: Product photo ads for fittings, rigging and sailwear, with one clear price line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
